portfolio_summary.description: JPMorgan Chase serves nearly 6 million small businesses across 48 states with 4,827 branches, the largest branch network in the United States.

industry_segments.name: Professional Services
industry_segments.description: Consulting, legal, accounting, marketing, and other knowledge-intensive professional services. High knowledge intensity with stable cash flows.

industry_segments.name: Retail Trade
industry_segments.description: Brick-and-mortar and e-commerce retail operations. Mixed fortunes with big-box footprints shrinking while online merchants require fulfillment-center financing.

industry_segments.name: Food Service
industry_segments.description: Restaurants, catering, and food production. Full-service restaurants led SBA 7(a) loans in 2024 with $419.4M in funding. High operational intensity.

industry_segments.name: Healthcare
industry_segments.description: Medical practices, dental offices, clinics, and healthcare services. Growing sector driven by demographic aging and equipment needs.

industry_segments.name: Construction
industry_segments.description: Contractors, builders, and trades. Resurgent amid on-shoring subsidies. Top risks include labor shortages, high interest rates, and project disputes.

industry_segments.name: Technology
industry_segments.description: Software, IT services, SaaS, and technology consulting. Fast-growing sector with strong fundamentals and low physical capital requirements.

industry_segments.name: Manufacturing
industry_segments.description: Production, fabrication, and assembly operations. Growing with on-shoring subsidies, requiring machinery leases and factory retrofits for automation.

industry_segments.name: Transportation & Logistics
industry_segments.description: Trucking, delivery services, and logistics operations. Equipment-intensive with moderate risk profile and stable growth.

regions.name: West
regions.description: Largest region led by California's 4.34M small businesses. Strong technology and professional services presence. Chase has 862 branches in CA alone.

regions.name: Northeast
regions.description: Dense, mature market with NY's 2.34M businesses. Strong in financial services and professional services. Chase operates 577 branches in NY, 192 in NJ.

regions.name: Southeast
regions.description: Fast-growing region led by Florida's 3.49M businesses. Strong population growth driving business expansion. Chase has 407 branches in FL.

regions.name: Midwest
regions.description: Industrial heartland with manufacturing resurgence. Chase has strong presence with 269 branches in IL, 265 in OH, 209 in MI.

regions.name: Southwest
regions.description: Texas-dominated region with 3.52M businesses. Energy and technology sectors driving growth. Chase operates 476 branches in TX.

concentration_metrics.geographic_diversification_notes: Well-diversified across 48 states with moderate concentration. West region (30%) and California (21.7%) lead but no extreme concentration risk. HHI of 0.142 indicates healthy geographic spread.

methodology: This analysis combines multiple authoritative data sources to map JPMorgan Chase's small business banking portfolio. Industry segment percentages are derived from SBA industry employment data (34.8M US small businesses), commercial banking sector lending patterns, and Chase's disclosed serving of 6M small businesses. Geographic distribution is based on Chase's 4,827 branch footprint across 48 states, FDIC branch data, state-level small business counts from SBA's 2024 Small Business Profiles, and Chase's stated 68% US population coverage. Portfolio exposure calculations use an estimated $285B total small business exposure (derived from Chase's commercial banking segment) with a $47,500 average exposure per business. Risk levels, pre-qualified rates, and growth trends incorporate 2024 industry risk assessments from Allianz Risk Barometer, SBA lending data showing restaurants leading with $419.4M in 7(a) loans, commercial banking market analyses indicating healthcare's 6.55% CAGR, and construction's resurgence with on-shoring. Where exact Chase-specific segment data was unavailable, allocations use weighted combinations of national small business industry distribution, commercial lending patterns, and Chase's operational footprint, ensuring all percentages sum to 100%.

estimated_with_strong_basis: Industry segment percentages (based on SBA employment data + commercial lending patterns)
Total portfolio exposure ($285B from commercial banking segment analysis)
Regional portfolio distribution (weighted by branch count + state business density)
Growth trends by industry (2024 market analyses)
modeled_assumptions: Average exposure per business ($47,500 - derived from total/count)
Pre-qualified rates by industry (based on risk profiles + SBA approval patterns)
Market share estimates by region (based on branch density + competitor analysis)
Default rates by industry (industry benchmark data)
